classificationPolicy.CLAIM_EXTENT_ERROR: The emitted occurrence overlaps a Gold occurrence but has a different extent, or Gold is partial against an emitted split/merged extent.
classificationPolicy.MODEL_SEMANTIC_MISCLASSIFICATION: The ontology can express the Gold occurrence, but the model omitted it or emitted a non-Gold semantic function/occurrence.
classificationPolicy.ONTOLOGY_GAP: Reserved for a source truth that cannot be represented by the current closed vocabulary without loss; no residual met this criterion.
classificationPolicy.CONTEXT_INSUFFICIENT: Reserved for evidence that the required source context was absent from the model-visible packet; not inferred from omission alone.
classificationPolicy.SOURCE_REPRESENTATION_ERROR: No residual assigned: sourceParts and source identity remained bindable.
classificationPolicy.BINDER_ERROR: No residual assigned: exact binding produced no unbindable candidate.
classificationPolicy.GOLD_OR_DEFINITION_AMBIGUITY: No residual assigned: no Gold authority ambiguity was evidenced by this score.
